criteria.note: Raycasts each PreRender from `GetMouseLocation` and excludes `{ self._Part, character }`. It steps out by `result.Normal * (BlockTypes.BlockSize / 2)` before `PlacementRules.snap`, hides on a miss with `Parent = nil`, and tints red when `check` fails. One flaw: with no PlacedBlocks folder, `canPlace` stays false, so the ghost shows red everywhere.
`Destroy` disconnects `_Connection` and destroys `_Part`. That is the only connection, so no frame update can run afterwards.

The `typeof(setmetatable({} :: {...}, GhostPreview))` type declares every field, and the constructor sets them all together. The part has `CanCollide = false` and `CanQuery = false`, and the raycast filter also excludes it.
The block type parameter is typed `BlockTypes.BlockType` and resolves under the checker. `GetPlacement` returns `(boolean, Vector3?)`, with the position nil on a miss.
An `Options` table carries `Transparency` and `RaycastDistance`, with defaults `DEFAULT_TRANSPARENCY` and `DEFAULT_RAYCAST_DISTANCE`.
It adds one file and nothing else, and luau-lsp, selene and StyLua all pass.

The logic is correct: half-block normal offset, snap, check against PlacedBlocks or an empty fallback folder, hide on a miss, and a nil-camera guard. It also relies on `BlockTypes.isBlockType` and `style.Transparency`, which luau-lsp could not verify because the require fails.
`destroy` disconnects `_connection` and destroys `_part`. It is safe to call twice.
`GhostPreviewData` declares all fields and is cast into `setmetatable`. The part does not collide and is excluded from queries.

The `WaitForChild` requires fail in luau-lsp (`Unknown require: unsupported path`), so `BlockTypes.BlockType` is unknown and the block type parameters are not really type-checked. `getTarget`'s `(Vector3?, boolean, string?)` return is reasonable.
An `Options` table holds documented fields, with named default constants and validating asserts.
The file is in scope, but luau-lsp reports 3 errors in this attempt's own require lines, so it isn't ready to merge.
